hermes-phone-remote v0.3.1 -> v0.3.2  —  incremental update package
=====================================================================
Contains only the files changed in this release. Copy them over the three
locations below, then restart the panel.

1) plugin.js
   -> %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\desktop-plugins\phone-remote\plugin.js

2) dashboard\plugin_api.py  and  dashboard\manifest.json
   -> %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\plugins\phone-remote\dashboard\

3) tools\pair_proxy.py
   -> %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\plugins\phone-remote\dashboard\tools\

What is new in v0.3.2: the pairing door's upstream is now a setting instead of
a hard-coded port. The gate is unchanged (cloudflared -> :9121, one-shot token,
approved-device cookie) — the setting only decides WHAT AN APPROVED PHONE SEES
after it gets through: the third-party WebUI (default, built for phones) or the
stock panel (previous behaviour). A new "Phone page" switcher in the WebUI card
does it in one click and replaces the running pair proxy, because a proxy only
reads its upstream once, at startup. If the WebUI is not running when the gate
starts, the panel starts it. The proxy now reports its upstream in /pair/_ver,
so the panel can tell a stale proxy (different upstream, or an older proxy that
reports none) from a current one.

Restart: click "Restart panel" in the panel (shutdown + respawn in one step),
then choose the phone page in the WebUI card. The desktop UI's "Connect phone"
button uses the desktop app's own backend, so that one needs a desktop restart
to see new routes. The frontend (plugin.js) hot-reloads the moment the file is
written.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
中文说明 / Chinese

只含本次改动的文件。解压后按下面 3 步覆盖，然后重启面板：

1) plugin.js -> %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\desktop-plugins\phone-remote\plugin.js
2) dashboard\plugin_api.py 与 dashboard\manifest.json
   -> %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\plugins\phone-remote\dashboard\
3) tools\pair_proxy.py
   -> %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\plugins\phone-remote\dashboard\tools\

v0.3.2 新增：门禁上游从写死的端口变成一个设置。门禁本身没动（还是
cloudflared -> :9121、一次性 token、已批准设备 cookie），这个设置只决定
「已批准的手机进门后看到谁」：第三方网页版 WebUI（默认，本来就是给手机做的）
或自带面板（原行为）。网页版卡里新增「手机页面」一键切换；切换会换掉正在跑的
门禁反代——反代只在启动时读一次上游，不换等于没切。起门禁时网页版没在跑，
面板会先把它拉起来。反代现在会在 /pair/_ver 里自报上游，面板据此判断在跑的
进程是不是过期的（上游不一样，或是改造前不报上游的旧进程）。

重启方式：面板里点「重启面板」（一步完成换届+拉起），然后在网页版卡里选「手机
页面」。桌面版 UI 的「连接手机」按钮走桌面版自己的后端，要重启桌面版才能看到新
路由；前端 plugin.js 写完文件即热重载，不需要额外动作。
